Metagross

Steel Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Metagross is a Steel/Psychic-type Iron Leg Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 550 kg. It evolves from Metang. Its highest base stat is Attack (135), with a base stat total of 600.
